name: F1 on the point-in-time top-20 perp universe
hypothesis: Replication by breadth: if F1's edge is crypto time-series momentum rather than a quirk of five majors, the identical rule must work on liquid perps never used in research, and trading ~20 of them gives roughly 1-2 trades a day.
rules: F1 unchanged (4h Donchian n=40 breakout, 3.5*ATR(14) stop, opposite 20-bar channel exit) on the monthly top-20 USD-M crypto perps by 90-day median quote volume, 0.30% risk per trade, at most 20 open positions; gated on the members other than BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/BNB.
